scientific_assessment: Independent reviews agree on analytic spatial derivatives, full-rule objective, unbiased supervised Adam estimator and L-BFGS algebra. No accuracy claim before actual fitting and PDE evaluation.

findings.topic: Teacher coverage, ordering and singular values
findings.disposition: NaN initialization and contiguous coverage checks added; actual singular values and exact array hashes bound to accepted training preparation. Existing PointVolumeStore owns common point ordering.

Reuse previously qualified native preparation and its complete source/semantic-byte replay, now hash-bound. No new FE gradient truth is invented from network outputs. Existing correction-space and non-symmetric analytic gradient controls remain required.

Complete runtime inventory and immutable prepared file-set checks in new launcher; genuine nine training Re checked; teacher identity and inherited source digest recorded; GPU/f64/highest and version receipts added. Final packet review remains required.
Verify selected checkpoint array SHA and parameter digest before loading; MODEL-RECEIPT binds saved bank SHA, selected theta, config and runtime.
Clarified dimensionless normalized velocity basis; solved coefficients reconstruct u/U. POD teacher modes are not themselves physical flow predictions.

First launch forbids resume. Serialization tests do not establish uninterrupted-optimizer equivalence. Future resumed jobs require separate integrated tests/review and must preserve lineage, failure status, gradient identity and prior checkpoint closure.

Summing job allocations for resource accounting is required and is not a cross-job performance comparison. Optimizer elapsed excludes setup; actual allocation time is charged separately. No comparative timing claim.
64GiB Slurm allocation is actual OS/job bound.16GiB is a conservative host-memory estimate and runtime RSS rejection threshold, not a CUDA virtual-address-space limit.

unchanged: Original failed bank and all prior evidence preserved
